name: Salman Sharif
title: Senior Software Engineer
tagline: Building robust software solutions that drive business growth
about: Hello and welcome to my website! My name is Salman and I was informally known as the "Bug Master" at my previous company, Flipp because not only was I great at finding issues within the software, I addressed these issues to the best of my ability as well. When joining a new organization or team, I seek opportunities for growth and facilitate inclusivity especially as the organization evolves. I have completed my Bachelor of Science degree specializing in Computer Science and Software Engineering from the University of Toronto Scarborough and I'm looking forward to applying what I have learned throughout my career.

educations.degree: Honours Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Software Engineering)

description: Engineered robust software solutions to optimize Amazon Ads campaigns, enhancing user experience and advertiser ROI to grow clients' businesses
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to innovate and integrate advanced features into the Perpetua / Flywheel Digital platform to capture new marketplaces
Pioneered the development of a recommendation system for ad campaigns, utilizing data analytics to drive strategic decisions and increase customer sales by 25%
Automated Mobile Banking manual test cases for release validation using Appium Scripts written in Java, decreasing time to production from 2 weeks to 2 days
Developed test cases for new features introduced by developer and design teams using ALM and Design Documentation, improving release and subsequent regression cycles
Onboarded new team members for the Automation team by creating documentation for setup/walkthroughs of automation tools, decreasing onboarding time by 4X
Created scripts for automating development tasks using Python, Testrail API, Jenkins, and CircleCI to reduce time to market of new features by 50%
Transitioned app from processing data on the app to the server by testing updated codebase, improving app performance by at least 2X
Identified 100+ issues within the iOS and Android Flipp app using documentation and requirement lists, achieving nomination of "Bug Master" within the organization
Created automated tools and test cases to simplify manual testing by 3X using HP Unified Functional Testing and Selenium
Performance tested multiple applications during upgrade from Oracle 11g to 12c DB, resulting in 3X performance improvement (30s to under 10s response time)
